verses.text: The Lord is king. He is clothed in majesty. The Lord is clothed in majesty and armed with strength. The world is set, and it cannot be moved.
Lord , your kingdom was set up long ago; you are everlasting.
Lord , the seas raise, the seas raise their voice. The seas raise up their pounding waves.
The sound of the water is loud; the ocean waves are powerful, but the Lord above is much greater.
Lord , your laws will stand forever. Your Temple will be holy forevermore.
